notes.title: Small Update v1.1.04
notes.content:
As we are about to launch Episode 2 very soon, I went through a few minor things to fix/improve Episode 1.

- Few localization fixes
- At the end, items are automatically transferred so players don’t have to click on each single item.
- Splash screens are skippable on ESC.
- A few more minor details.

tags.feature: - At the end, items are automatically transferred so players don’t have to click on each single item.
- Splash screens are skippable on ESC.

notes.title: Full Voice Over Update Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398339/81e9711360d15d7fcda220db031d5defb8078c9e.png[/img]
We have some exciting news! After a lot of thinking, we've decided to go ahead and update the game with full voice acting. 

We're still searching for voice actors, and it will also take us some time till we implement this considering that the game has over 28.000 words.

But you can expect this update in a few weeks. You can keep the track of our progress on our social media pages:

https://twitter.com/schemingthrough
https://www.facebook.com/SchemingThrough/

tags.feature: We have some exciting news! After a lot of thinking, we've decided to go ahead and update the game with full voice acting.
